title: Publication-Quality ggplot2 Annotation
text: objective ggscribe provide annotation helper functions publication-quality ‘ggplot2’ visualisation. Note: Use secondary axis, subtitle, axis titles adjust space. axis_* functions placed outside panel require clip = "" coord space. panel_shade geoms.

title: Publication-Quality ggplot2 Annotation
text: Install CRAN, development version GitHub.
code: install.packages("ggscribe") pak::pak("davidhodge931/ggscribe")

title: Publication-Quality ggplot2 Annotation
text: ggscribe provides various axis panel annotation helper functions.  function ensure text easily coloured contrast fill aesthetic.
code: library(ggplot2) library(dplyr)  set_theme(   ggrefine::theme_grey(     panel_heights = rep(unit(50, "mm"), 100),     panel_widths = rep(unit(75, "mm"), 100),   ) )  mtcars |>   ggplot(aes(x = wt, y = mpg, colour = as.factor(gear), fill = as.factor(gear))) +   scale_colour_discrete(palette = blends::multiply(get_theme()$palette.colour.discrete)) +   #clip = "off" is required for axis_text, axis_ticks and axis_bracket   coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +   #reference lines and shade   ggscribe::reference_line(xintercept = 2.4) +   ggscribe::reference_line(yintercept = 12)  +   ggscribe::panel_shade(     xmin = 4,     xmax = 5,   ) +   #top axis   scale_x_continuous(     sec.axis = ggscribe::sec_axis_text(       breaks = c(mean(c(4, 5))),       labels = c("Range"),       guide = ggscribe::guide_sec_axis_text(         angle = 90,       )     )   ) +   ggscribe::axis_bracket(     position = "top",     breaks = c(4, 5),   ) +   ggscribe::axis_text(     position = "top",     breaks = c(2.4),     labels = c("Threshold"),   ) +   #right axis   ggscribe::axis_text(     position = "right",     breaks = 12,     labels = "Threshold",   ) +   #bottom axis   ggscribe::axis_ticks(     position = "bottom",     breaks = 3.8,     length = rel(4.5),   ) +   ggscribe::axis_text(     position = "bottom",     breaks = 3.8,     labels = "Threshold",     length = rel(4.5),   ) +   labs(x = "\nWeight") +   #geom   geom_point() +   #annotations fit plot   theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "grey92")) ggwidth::set_equiwidth(equiwidth = 1.75)  mtcars |>   count(cyl, am) |>   mutate(     am = if_else(am == 0, "Automatic", "Manual"),     cyl = as.factor(cyl)   ) |>   ggplot(aes(x = am, y = n, colour = cyl, fill = cyl, label = n)) +   geom_col(     position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single", padding = 0.05),     width = ggwidth::get_width(n = 2, n_dodge = 3),   ) +   scale_fill_discrete(palette = jumble::jumble) +   scale_colour_discrete(palette = blends::multiply(jumble::jumble)) +   geom_text(     mapping = ggscribe::aes_contrast(), # or aes(!!!ggscribe::aes_contrast()),     position = position_dodge2(       width = ggwidth::get_width(n = 2, n_dodge = 3),       padding = 0.05,       preserve = "single"),     vjust = 1.33,     show.legend = FALSE,   ) +   scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +   ggrefine::modern(x_type = "discrete")

title: Annotate an axis bracket — axis_bracket
text: Draws one brackets along axis edge floating data position. bracket spans min(breaks) max(breaks) caps every break value. bar uses rendering path axis_line(); caps use path axis_ticks(). Requires coord_cartesian(clip = "").

title: Annotate an axis bracket — axis_bracket
code: axis_bracket(   ...,   position = NULL,   breaks,   colour = NULL,   linewidth = NULL,   linetype = NULL,   length = ggplot2::rel(1),   layout = NULL,   xintercept = NULL,   yintercept = NULL )

title: Annotate an axis bracket — axis_bracket
text: ... used. Forces named arguments. position One "top", "bottom", "left", "right". Inferred xintercept yintercept provided. breaks numeric vector length >= 2 data coordinates, wrapped () normalised panel coordinates (npc), (0) left/bottom edge (1) right/top edge panel. bar spans min(breaks) max(breaks); caps drawn every break value. Pass list vectors draw multiple brackets one call — e.g. breaks = list(c(2, 4), c(6, 8)) draws two brackets. Style args intercepts recycled number brackets. colour Inherits axis.ticks set theme. May vector length number brackets. linewidth Inherits axis.ticks set theme. Supports rel(). May vector length number brackets. linetype Inherits axis.ticks set theme. May vector length number brackets. length Length bracket caps. Supports rel(). Negative values flip cap direction. Defaults rel(1). May vector length number brackets. layout Controls panels annotation appears . NULL (default) repeats panels. integer targets specific panel. "fixed" repeats panels ignoring faceting variables. See ggplot2::layer() full details. xintercept "left"/"right" axes: float bracket x positions data coordinates. Paired 1:1 brackets — bracket gets intercept, recycling applies. yintercept "top"/"bottom" axes: float bracket y positions data coordinates. Paired 1:1 brackets — bracket gets intercept, recycling applies.

code: library(ggplot2) library(dplyr)  set_theme(   ggrefine::theme_grey(     panel_heights = rep(unit(50, "mm"), 100),     panel_widths = rep(unit(75, "mm"), 100),   ) )  mtcars |>   ggplot(aes(x = wt, y = mpg, colour = as.factor(gear), fill = as.factor(gear))) +   scale_colour_discrete(palette = blends::multiply(get_theme()$palette.colour.discrete)) +   #clip = "off" is required for axis_text, axis_ticks and axis_bracket   coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +   #reference lines and shade   ggscribe::reference_line(xintercept = 2.4) +   ggscribe::reference_line(yintercept = 12)  +   ggscribe::panel_shade(     xmin = 4,     xmax = 5,   ) +   #top axis   scale_x_continuous(     sec.axis = ggscribe::sec_axis_text(       breaks = c(mean(c(4, 5))),       labels = c("Range"),       guide = ggscribe::guide_sec_axis_text(         angle = 90,       )     )   ) +   ggscribe::axis_bracket(     position = "top",     breaks = c(4, 5),   ) +   ggscribe::axis_text(     position = "top",     breaks = c(2.4),     labels = c("Threshold"),   ) +   #right axis   ggscribe::axis_text(     position = "right",     breaks = 12,     labels = "Threshold",   ) +   #geom   geom_point() +   #annotations fit plot   theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "grey92"))

text: convenience wrapper around sec_axis_text() reserves vertical (horizontal) space (beside) axis without drawing visible text. Useful pushing axis titles away panel make room annotations added axis_text(), axis_ticks(), axis_bracket().

title: Secondary axis for providing space for text annotations — sec_axis_spacer
text: breaks function numeric vector giving break position(s) used anchor text. Defaults NULL, places single label midpoint scale — mean limits continuous scales. labels character string used spacer. Defaults "". Use repeated newlines (e.g. "\n") word fit. name name secondary axis. Use ggplot2::waiver() derive name primary axis, NULL (default) name. guide guide object used render axis. Defaults guide_sec_axis_spacer(), makes transparent ticks lines. ... Additional arguments passed ggplot2::dup_axis().
